# CWE-353: Missing Support for Integrity Check — IaC Detection Guide

## Core Weakness Categories to Detect

### 1. Artifact/Package Download Without Integrity Verification
Occurs when IaC scripts fetch external resources without validating their integrity.

**Keywords & Attributes:**
- `checksum`, `hash`, `sha256`, `sha512`, `md5`, `digest` — **absent** from download blocks
- `skip_checksum`, `disable_checksum`, `no_verify` — set to `true`
- `verify: false`, `insecure: true`, `unsafe: true`
- `checksum_type: none` or omitted entirely
- Download source URLs without an accompanying `checksum_url` or `checksum_value`

---

### 2. Container Image Integrity Not Enforced
Mutable image references allow silently substituted images.

**Keywords & Attributes:**
- `image` fields referencing only a mutable tag (e.g., `latest`, `stable`) without a digest pin
- Absence of `@sha256:` digest in image references
- `content_trust`, `image_signing`, `cosign_verify` — missing or disabled
- `pull_policy: always` without accompanying digest verification
- `allow_insecure_images: true`

---

### 3. Protocol/Transport Configuration Lacking Integrity Mechanisms

**Keywords & Attributes:**
- Protocol set to plain/unencrypted variants (e.g., `http://`, `ftp://`, `udp`)
- `checksum_enabled: false`
- `integrity_check: disabled`
- `data_validation: false`
- `etag_check: false` or absent
- Missing `content_md5` or equivalent field in object storage operations
- `disable_content_type_verification: true`

---

### 4. Package/Dependency Resolution Without Hash Locking

**Keywords & Attributes:**
- Dependency version ranges without pinned hashes (e.g., `>=1.0` without hash)
- Missing `integrity`, `lock`, `hash_lock`, or `pinned_hash` fields
- `allow_unverified: true`
- `trust_on_first_use`, `tofu: true` — accepting first received content without verification
- `skip_integrity_check: true`

---

### 5. Data Transfer / Storage Without Integrity Validation

**Keywords & Attributes:**
- `checksum_algorithm: none` or omitted on object storage resources
- Missing `enable_checksum`, `server_side_checksum`, or `data_integrity` fields
- `validate_content: false`
- Replication or transfer configurations without `checksum_validation` block
- `skip_validation: true` in data pipeline configurations

---

### 6. Message / API / Webhook Integrity Not Enforced

**Keywords & Attributes:**
- Missing `webhook_secret`, `signing_key`, `hmac_secret`, or `message_signature` fields
- `signature_verification: disabled` or absent
- `verify_signature: false`
- Missing `x-hub-signature`, `x-signature`, or equivalent header enforcement
- `replay_protection: false`

---

### 7. Software Update / Provisioning Without Verification

**Keywords & Attributes:**
- `gpg_check: false`, `signature_check: false`, `repo_gpgcheck: false`
- Missing `public_key`, `trusted_key`, or `key_fingerprint` fields
- `allow_unsigned: true`, `skip_gpg_check: true`
- Provisioner scripts using raw download without a validation step following it

---

## Summary Table

| Weakness Area | Key Indicators |
|---|---|
| Download integrity | Missing `checksum`, `sha256`, `hash` fields |
| Container images | Tag-only references; no `@sha256:` digest |
| Protocol selection | Plain `http`, `ftp`, `udp` without app-level checksum |
| Dependency locking | Missing integrity hashes in dependency specs |
| Storage/transfer | `checksum_algorithm` absent or `none` |
| Messaging/APIs | Missing `hmac_secret`, `signing_key`, `signature_verification` |
| Update mechanisms | `gpg_check: false`, `allow_unsigned: true` |

## Detection Heuristics

- **Presence of download/fetch operations** without an immediately following checksum comparison step
- **`true` values** on any attribute containing: `skip`, `disable`, `allow`, `insecure`, `unsafe` combined with `checksum`, `verify`, `integrity`, or `signature`
- **Absence of integrity-related blocks** in resource definitions that interact with external data sources
- **Mutable version references** (floating tags, version ranges) without accompanying hash pins

iterations.rego_code:
package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^(gpg_check|signature_check|repo_gpgcheck|checksum_enabled|verify_signature|validate_content|data_validation|signature_verification|integrity_check|content_trust|image_signing|cosign_verify|verify|checksum_validation|enable_checksum|data_integrity)$", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == false
    result := {
        "type": "sec_no_int_check",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Missing support for integrity check - An integrity check attribute is explicitly disabled. (CWE-353)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^(skip_checksum|disable_checksum|no_verify|insecure|unsafe|allow_unsigned|skip_gpg_check|allow_unverified|skip_integrity_check|allow_insecure_images|tofu|trust_on_first_use|disable_content_type_verification|skip_validation)$", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == true
    result := {
        "type": "sec_no_int_check",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Missing support for integrity check - A security bypass attribute is explicitly enabled. (CWE-353)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)(checksum|integrity|signature|verification|validation|gpg)", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)^(none|disabled|false|off|no)$", attr.value.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_no_int_check",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Missing support for integrity check - An integrity-related attribute is set to none or disabled. (CWE-353)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^image$", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i):(latest|stable|edge|master|main|current|release|dev|nightly|snapshot)$", attr.value.value)
    not regex.match("@sha256:[a-fA-F0-9]+", attr.value.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_no_int_check",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Missing support for integrity check - Container image uses a mutable tag without a digest pin. (CWE-353)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^(url|source|src|download|fetch|uri|remote_url|download_url)$", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)^(http|ftp)://", attr.value.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_no_int_check",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Missing support for integrity check - Resource is fetched over an insecure protocol without integrity verification. (CWE-353)"
    }
}
